headline: Tech sold off again and Nasdaq closed at its lows; Palantir's after-hours beat is a partial offset.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite fell about 1.1% to near 25,164, closing at the session low and below Friday's low as tech weakness resumed, while VIX rose about 9% to 21 and the 10-year yield eased 3 bp to 4.91%. Palantir beat estimates and raised guidance after the bell, which may steady AI names early in the Asia session. The key risk is continued de-risking ahead of Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections, Apple earnings and Friday's jobs report.

sources.title: CNBC: Nasdaq starts November with 1% loss
